home.learnMoreSubtitle: Everything you need to know for {{country}} citizens
home.learnMorePara1: Travelers need a visa to visit India for Tourism for a maximum stay of 180 days in 1 calendar year.
home.learnMorePara2: An India eVisa is the fastest and easiest way of obtaining a visa for India because travelers can submit their applications and supporting documents online. Once the application is approved, travelers receive their eVisa confirmation electronically.
home.learnMorePara3: A valid visa is required to board the flight. If the visa is expired or doesn't match the traveler's passport information, travelers will not be able to board their flight.
home.learnMorePara4: Entry to India with an eVisa is supported at 29 airports and five seaports. This visa requirement doesn't apply to travelers with a valid OCI card or travelers with a valid PIO card.

home.faq2Title: How long can I stay in India with my eVisa?

home.faq3Title: How long is my {{visaName}} valid for?
home.faq3Ans: Your eVisa is valid for {{validity}} from the arrival date included in your application.

about.missionText: We make the visa application process transparent, fast, and stress-free for travelers worldwide.
about.missionText1: Clear eVisa Services is a specialist Indian eVisa consultancy. about.missionText2: We don't submit applications on your behalf. Instead, we meticulously review every document and piece of information against India's eVisa requirements and prepare proper documentation so that when you submit on India's official portal, everything is in order the first time.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about the Indian eVisa
faq.cantFind: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Our customer support team is here to help.
faq.a1: Clear eVisa is a specialist Indian eVisa consultancy service. We verify all required documents and information for your India eVisa application, and prepare a complete, accurate documentation package — so you can submit on India's official portal with confidence, without errors that could lead to rejection or delay.
faq.a2: Yes, our service is completely legal. Clear eVisa Services is a registered consultancy operating in full compliance with applicable laws. We do not provide immigration legal advice. Instead, we review your documents and information against India's eVisa requirements and prepare accurate documentation to help you submit correctly on the official Government portal.
faq.q3: Do I need to create an account?
faq.a3: Yes, creating an account is required to use our platform. This allows you to save your progress, access your applications, and receive updates about your visa status.
faq.q4: How do I reset my password?
faq.a4: Click the 'Forgot Password' link on the sign-in page. Enter your email address, and we'll send you instructions to reset your password. Follow the link in the email and create a new password.
faq.q5: Can I get assistance for multiple family members?
faq.a5: Yes, we can assist multiple travellers — such as family members travelling together. Each person's documents and information are verified and prepared independently. Each traveller will need their own application submission on the official portal.
faq.q6: What India eVisa types do you support?
faq.a6: We specialise exclusively in India eVisa. We support all five India eVisa types: Tourist (30-day, 1-year, and 5-year), Business, Medical, Medical Attendant, and Conference eVisas — for eligible passport holders from 193+ nationalities.
faq.a7: Required documents vary by India eVisa type. Our platform provides a personalised document checklist based on your nationality and the visa type you are applying for. Common requirements include a digital passport photo, passport scan, and supporting documents such as a business letter or medical certificate depending on the visa category.
faq.a8: Yes, you can complete your application and upload documents anytime before final submission. However, you cannot submit your application until all required documents are uploaded.
faq.a9: Our consultancy fee covers thorough document verification, expert review of your information against India's eVisa requirements, and preparation of your complete documentation package. Government eVisa fees are paid directly by you at the time of submission on India's official portal. All fees are clearly displayed before payment.
faq.q10: Is it safe to pay online?
faq.a10: Yes, all payments are processed through secure, encrypted connections using industry-standard security protocols. We use reputable payment processors and never store your complete credit card information.
faq.q11: How long does visa processing take?
faq.a11: India eVisa processing by the Indian Government typically takes 3–5 business days after you submit on the official portal. Our consultancy ensures your documents are verified and correctly prepared before you submit, reducing the risk of delays caused by errors or missing information.
faq.q12: Can I track my application status?
faq.a12: Yes, you can track your application status 24/7 through your account dashboard. We also send email notifications for important updates.
faq.a13: Our consultancy fee covers document verification, information review, and preparation of your documentation. It does not cover the Government of India eVisa fee, which you pay separately when submitting on the official portal. Once our document review and preparation is complete, our service fee is non-refundable. See our Refund Policy for full details.
faq.a14: We support all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and Opera. For the best experience, please use the latest version of your browser.
faq.q15: Can I use the platform on my phone?
faq.a15: Yes, our platform is fully mobile-responsive and works on all smartphones and tablets. You can start an application on one device and continue on another.
faq.a16: We offer 24/7 customer support through multiple channels: live chat on our website, email support, and phone support. You can also explore our comprehensive Help Center for self-service answers.
faq.q17: Do you provide immigration legal advice?
faq.a17: We provide information and guidance on application requirements, but we do not provide legal advice. For legal questions, we recommend consulting with a qualified immigration attorney.
faq.q18: How do you protect my data?
faq.a18: We implement comprehensive security measures including SSL encryption, secure data centers, regular audits, and strict access controls. See our Privacy Policy for complete details.

helpCenter.title: Help Center
helpCenter.subtitle: Find guides, FAQs, and support resources
helpCenter.didntFind: Didn't find what you're looking for?
helpCenter.contactSupportDesc: Our support team is here to help. Contact us through email.
helpCenter.q1: How do I create an account?
helpCenter.a1: To create an account, click the 'Sign Up' button on our homepage. Enter your email address, create a strong password, and agree to our terms. You'll receive a verification email to confirm your account.
helpCenter.q2: What information do I need to get started?
helpCenter.a2: You'll need basic personal information including your full name, date of birth, passport number, and email address. We'll guide you through collecting additional information as needed for your specific visa type.
helpCenter.q3: Can I save my progress and continue later?
helpCenter.a3: Yes! Your application is automatically saved as you complete each section. You can log back in anytime to continue where you left off.
helpCenter.q4: How long does the consultancy process take?
helpCenter.a4: The document verification and preparation process typically takes 1–2 business days after you submit all required information and documents to us. Once your documentation package is ready, you can submit on India's official eVisa portal yourself. The Indian Government's eVisa processing then typically takes a further 3–5 business days.
helpCenter.q5: Which India eVisa types do you support?
helpCenter.a5: We specialise exclusively in India eVisa. We support all five types: Tourist (30-day, 1-year, and 5-year), Business, Medical, Medical Attendant, and Conference eVisas — for passport holders from 193+ eligible nationalities.
helpCenter.q6: Can you assist multiple family members travelling together?
helpCenter.a6: Yes. We can verify and prepare documentation for multiple travellers in the same family group. Each person's documents are reviewed independently. Each traveller must submit their own application on the official portal.
helpCenter.q7: What file formats are accepted for document uploads?
helpCenter.a7: We accept PDF, JPG, PNG, and DOC/DOCX files. Files should be clear and legible, with a maximum size of 10MB per file.
helpCenter.q8: How do I know which documents I need?
helpCenter.a8: We provide a personalized document checklist based on your visa type and destination country. The checklist will be shown during the application process, and you can download it for reference.
helpCenter.q9: Can I edit or replace uploaded documents?
helpCenter.a9: Yes, you can replace any uploaded document before submitting your final application. After submission, contact our support team if you need to make changes.
helpCenter.q10: What payment methods do you accept?
helpCenter.a10: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), debit cards, and digital wallets (PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay).
helpCenter.a11: Yes, all payments are processed through encrypted connections using industry-standard security protocols. We never store your complete credit card information on our servers.
helpCenter.q12: What's included in the consultancy fee?
helpCenter.a12: Our consultancy fee covers: thorough verification of all your documents against India's eVisa requirements, expert review of your information to catch errors before submission, preparation of a complete documentation package, and customer support throughout the process. Government eVisa fees are paid separately by you on the official portal.
helpCenter.q13: How do I check my application status?
helpCenter.a13: You can check your application status anytime by logging into your account and visiting the 'My Applications' section. You'll see detailed status updates for each application.
helpCenter.q14: Will I receive notifications about my application?
helpCenter.a14: Yes, we send email notifications for important updates including submission confirmation, document verification status, and final decisions.
helpCenter.q15: How long does India eVisa processing take?
helpCenter.a15: The Indian Government typically processes eVisa applications within 3–5 business days of submission. Our consultancy ensures your documents are verified and error-free before you submit, minimising the risk of processing delays or rejection.
helpCenter.a16: We support Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge browsers on both desktop and mobile devices. For the best experience, please keep your browser updated to the latest version.
helpCenter.q17: I'm having trouble uploading documents. What should I do?
helpCenter.a17: Ensure your file size is under 10MB and in a supported format (PDF, JPG, PNG, DOC/DOCX). Clear your browser cache and try again. If problems persist, contact our support team.
helpCenter.a18: Yes, our platform is fully responsive and works seamlessly on mobile devices, tablets, and desktops. You can start an application on your phone and continue on your computer.

hero.subheading: Ancient temples, royal palaces, golden beaches, and the world's most vibrant street life — all in one extraordinary country.

destinations.title: Iconic Destinations
destinations.subtitle: Six unmissable corners of a country that contains multitudes.
destinations.tajMahalDesc: One of the Seven Wonders of the World — a breathtaking white-marble mausoleum on the banks of the Yamuna river.
destinations.keralaDesc: Glide through emerald lagoons and palm-fringed canals on a traditional houseboat in God's Own Country.
destinations.rajasthanDesc: Majestic forts, vibrant bazaars and golden deserts — the Land of Kings is unlike anywhere else on Earth.
destinations.goaDesc: Sun-soaked shores, Portuguese architecture, fresh seafood and legendary sunsets along 100 km of coastline.
destinations.varanasiDesc: Witness the eternal Ganga Aarti on the ghats of the world's oldest continuously inhabited city.
destinations.himachalDesc: Snow-capped peaks, alpine meadows and hill stations nestled in the mighty Himalayas.

whyIndia.title: A universe of experiences in one country
whyIndia.cuisineDesc: From butter chicken in Delhi to dosa in Chennai — every state is a new culinary universe.
whyIndia.heritageDesc: Over 3,000 years of history: Mughal forts, ancient temples, Buddhist stupas and colonial architecture.
whyIndia.coastlineDesc: 7,500 km of coastline spanning the Arabian Sea, Indian Ocean and Bay of Bengal.
whyIndia.wildlifeDesc: Bengal tigers, Asiatic lions, Indian elephants and over 1,300 bird species in their natural habitat.
whyIndia.festivalsDesc: Diwali, Holi, Navratri, Pongal — India's festivals are a riot of colour, music and joy.
whyIndia.photographyDesc: Every street corner is a composition — from misty mountain villages to neon-lit city nights.

bestTime.title: Best time to visit
bestTime.peakDesc: Cool and dry across most of the country. Best for the Golden Triangle, Rajasthan, Goa and South India. Festive season includes Diwali and Christmas.
bestTime.summerDesc: Hot on the plains but perfect for the Himalayas and hill stations like Shimla, Manali and Ooty. Lighter crowds and lower prices in most areas.
bestTime.monsoonDesc: Lush green landscapes and dramatic waterfalls. Kerala, Goa and the Western Ghats are spectacular. Hotels offer significant discounts.

faq.title: FAQs
faq.q1: Do I need a visa to visit India?
faq.a1: Most passport holders require a visa. Citizens of 193+ nationalities are eligible for India eVisa — a convenient online process. Clear eVisa Services helps you verify all required documents and prepares your documentation so your submission on the official portal is error-free.
faq.q2: What is the best time to visit India?
faq.a2: October to March is generally the best time for most of India — pleasant temperatures and low humidity. The Himalayas are best in summer (April–June). The Kerala backwaters are beautiful year-round. Monsoon season (July–September) transforms the landscape and is spectacular in the Western Ghats.
faq.q3: What India eVisa types are available for tourists?
faq.a3: Tourist eVisa comes in three durations: 30-day (single/double entry), 1-year (multiple entry), and 5-year (multiple entry). Each stay is limited to 90 or 180 days per visit depending on the visa type. Clear eVisa Services can help you choose the right type and prepare your documentation.
faq.a4: India is a safe and welcoming destination visited by millions of tourists every year. Standard travel precautions apply. The Government of India has significantly improved tourist infrastructure across all major destinations in recent years.
faq.q5: What currency is used in India?
faq.a5: The Indian Rupee (INR). ATMs are widely available in cities and tourist areas. Major credit cards are accepted at hotels, restaurants and larger shops. Carry some cash for local markets and rural areas.
